title: Inability to Dismiss Subscription Notification / Offer
body:
The reason I bought Habit in the first place was that it didn’t have a subscription based model. I will happily pay a one time payment for the app rather than renting it. 

The thing that bothered me the most was that the app didn’t even allow me to dismiss the discounted app subscription notification it created right above my “habits”. 

Cleanliness and beautiful design was what separated this app from others and seeing this subscription thing whenever I open the app is not what I admired about the app.
author: Shahrez Qureshi

title: Brilliant app!
